description: Pedestrian Footfall Malahide Demense Gates 2023 2025 FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. This data set contains the details of pedestrian footfall into Malahide Demesne through the various gates. This includes data from 2023,2024,2025 and 2026 and as per the numbers walking through the gates. Malahide Demesne has a lot to offer with great views and Walled Garden, Butterfly Garden and House Tours. Kids Playground and coffee shop. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are Arts, Arts Culture and Heritage, Community Culture and Heritage, Dublin, Dublin Costal Trail. It offers 5 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, HTML, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
